The '''NX-14 Needler''' was a type of [[Needler/Legends|needler]] designed to penetrate [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] by firing a sharp, [[Ferroceramic/Legends|ferroceramic]] dart. The dart could also be laced with contact [[Poison/Legends|poison]], delivering the poison to its targets.

==Description==
Debuted by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the NX-14 was one of the smallest, most compact needler produced by the company. Palm-sized, the weapon was made of an inert, light-absorbing fibermesh polycarbonate. Its internals were shielded which aided the weapon in being easily concealable and nearly impossible to find when hidden.<ref name="EV" />
